# Carpenterwala

> Carpenterwala is India's homeowner knowledge base and verified home improvement marketplace connecting homeowners directly with background-checked carpenters, painters, plumbers, and electricians at 0% platform commission. On-site verified technician bookings are currently active across Bangalore, while our how-to guides, cost calculators, and material benchmarks serve Indian homeowners nationwide.

## Core Trade Services (Bangalore Service Availability)
- [Carpentry Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/carpentry): Custom furniture assembly, modular kitchen fitting, door lock installation, hydraulic hinge replacement, wardrobe repairs.
- [Painting Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/painting): Interior and exterior wall painting, texture accent walls, waterproofing, damp-proof putty treatment.
- [Plumbing Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/plumbing): Tap & faucet replacement, pipe leak repair, water heater installation, overhead water tank deep cleaning, kitchen drain unclogging.
- [Electrical Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/electrical): Switchboard fitting, MCB trip diagnostics, fuse repair, house rewiring, ceiling fan & light fixture installation.
- [All Services Directory](https://carpenterwala.com/services): Browse all 13 trades including Tank & Sump Cleaner, AC Technician, Mason, Welder, and Flooring Expert.

## Homeowner Knowledge Base & National Guides
- [Carpenterwala Blog Hub](https://carpenterwala.com/blog): Complete repository of 130+ practical home maintenance, repair, and material cost guides for Indian homeowners.
- [Wardrobe Cost in India](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/wardrobe-cost-india-materials-labour-quote-guide): Comprehensive guide to wardrobe pricing, BWR vs commercial ply, door styles, and contractor quote checklists.
- [Modular Kitchen Cost in India](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/modular-kitchen-cost-india-budget-materials-hidden-extras): Realistic kitchen budget breakdown, material comparisons (acrylic/laminate), and hidden costs quotes leave out.
- [False Ceiling Cost POP vs Gypsum](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/false-ceiling-cost-india-pop-gypsum-pvc): Material comparison of gypsum, POP, and PVC false ceilings, lighting planning, and installation prices.
- [Wallpaper vs Paint for Indian Homes](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/wallpaper-vs-paint-for-indian-homes): Where to use wallpaper vs emulsion paint, peel-and-stick installation tutorial, and dampness management.
- [Terrace Waterproofing Methods & Cost](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/terrace-waterproofing-india-methods-cost-contractor-checklist): Complete breakdown of elastomeric polyurethane coatings, APP membranes, crack injection, and ponding flood test checklists.
- [Bathroom Renovation Cost in India](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/bathroom-renovation-cost-india-plumbing-tiles-fixtures): Budget breakdown for plumbing, anti-skid tiles, Jaquar/Kohler sanitaryware, and strict renovation sequencing.
- [House Wiring & Rewiring Cost in India](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/house-wiring-rewiring-cost-india-points-materials-labour): Point-based electrical pricing, FRLS copper wire grades, RCCB/ELCB shock protection, and distribution box planning.
- [CPVC vs UPVC Pipes for Home Plumbing](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/cpvc-vs-upvc-pipes-home-plumbing-india): Pressure ratings, hot vs cold water compatibility, and solvent cement guidelines.
- [Overhead & Sump Tank Cleaning Cost](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/overhead-sump-water-tank-cleaning-cost-india): Professional tank cleaning methods, capacity-based pricing, UV disinfection, and confined-space safety.
- [Balcony & Terrace Gardening for Beginners](https://carpenterwala.com/blog/balcony-terrace-gardening-beginners-india): Lightweight soil blends, potting mix, seasonal plant choices, and drainage protection for Indian apartments.

## Interactive Tools & Calculators
- [Paint Cost & Quantity Estimator](https://carpenterwala.com/services/painting#calculator): Estimates wall painting square footage, primer requirement, litres of paint, and labor costs for 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK flats.
- [Water Wastage & Tap Drip Calculator](https://carpenterwala.com/services/plumbing#calculator): Calculates daily and monthly water loss (in litres and ₹ Rupees) caused by leaking taps, flush tanks, and pipes in Indian households.
- [Electricity Wastage & Bill Calculator](https://carpenterwala.com/services/electrical#calculator): Estimates monthly kWh power consumption, electrical wastage, and electricity bill impacts for appliances (fans, ACs, geysers, refrigerators).

## Benchmark Labor Rate Cards (Bangalore Active Service Areas)
- **Carpentry**: Door lock fitting (₹250–₹450), Modular kitchen hydraulic hinge repair (₹180–₹350), Custom wardrobe assembly (₹600–₹1,200).
- **Painting**: 1 BHK interior repainting (₹4,500–₹7,500), 2 BHK repainting (₹8,000–₹13,000), Damp-proofing putty (₹18–₹32/sq ft).
- **Plumbing**: Tap/faucet replacement (₹150–₹300), Overhead water tank cleaning (₹699–₹1,299), Kitchen drain unclogging (₹200–₹400).
- **Electrical**: Switchboard repair (₹120–₹250), MCB trip diagnostics (₹200–₹450), Ceiling fan installation (₹150–₹300).

## Verification & Trust Signals
- **Identity & Background Checks**: Mandatory Aadhaar verification, trade skill testing, and thorough multi-point background checks for all listed professionals.
- **Direct Marketplace**: 0% platform commission; homeowners connect and pay technicians directly with zero hidden markups.
- **Fast Dispatch**: Verified local handymen dispatch quickly across serviced Bangalore clusters (typically within 60 to 90 minutes during standard operating hours).

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) & AI Agent Integration
Carpenterwala exposes a Remote WebMCP server and OpenAPI 3.1 specification for autonomous AI agents (Google Gemini on Android, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, and Perplexity).

- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp/openapi.json): Complete machine-readable API specification and schema definitions.
- [Remote WebMCP Server](https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp): Live JSON-RPC 2.0 / SSE endpoint for agent tool calls.
- **Available Tools**:
  - `initiate_technician_onboarding`: Onboards service professionals with privacy-preserving SMS/OTP links.
  - `check_technician_application_status`: Checks verification or active badge status by 10-digit mobile number.
  - `search_verified_pros`: Finds verified tradesmen filtered by trade and Bangalore locality.
  - `get_service_rate_card`: Retrieves standard zero-commission labor rate cards and job durations.
  - `calculate_service_estimate`: Computes wall painting quantities, tap water loss, or electrical power wastage.
  - `request_service_callback`: Connects homeowners with nearby verified pros for urgent repairs.
